legal_basis.regulation_observation: CMS deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, as defined by section 4(12) of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act, to be in compliance with Part 180.
legal_basis.statute_observation: The definition of Indian Health Program includes a tribal health program; a tribal health program is a tribe or tribal organization operating a health facility funded in whole or part by the Indian Health Service through an ISDEAA contract or compact.

interpretation: The exact-CCN CMS record identifies Hu Hu Kam Memorial Hospital at 483 West Seed Farm Road in Sacaton, Arizona. CMS's own service locator independently identifies that hospital/address as Title 5 (638), and the current operator identifies the same hospital as a GRHC location while GRHC identifies itself as a federally recognized 638 entity. Read together with 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) and the 25 USC 1603 definitions, the evidence supports classifying this hospital under the Indian Health Program scope category. CMS's Government - Federal ownership field is retained as a separate fact. This scope classification does not assert pointer linkage, MRF availability, file quality, or legal compliance beyond the regulation's deemed-compliance classification.
next_action: Retain the supported Indian Health Program scope classification and the prior 404/historical-PDF observations as provenance only.
